heading: **8 April 2026**
body:
*GP5d pHRS PlasmidFS*  
 

![](assets/img/doc3-image13.png)

We use 7.5 uL of DNA, 1.5 uL Cas9 RNP, 1 uL Nuclease reaction buffer.

Set up multiple reactions for both the 12h and 18h time-point samples.

*Quantification of NCFS-PNK & HTFS samples*

Qubit was used to quantify the following samples:

NCFS-N40-PNK: 20.4 ng/uL

NCFS-147-PNK: 20 ng/uL

HTFS-N40: 92.2 ng/uL

HTFS-147: 75 ng/uL

*Preparation of lig20K samples for nucleosome reconstitution*

Use the gTube to shred lig50k to lig20k.

Take 3 ug of lig50k and spin at 4200 rpm, 60 s.

lig20k \= 20.6 ng/uL

*PNK-treatment of HTFS samples*  
\[2 reactions per HTFS sample\]

| DNA | 25 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 5 uL |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 2 µl (20 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl  |

Incubate 37 C, 40 mins. Deactivate 65 C, 20 mins. Freeze tubes at \-20 C.

*NCFS samples*

NOTE: During the PNK treatment of these samples I had set up a 50 uL reaction (containing \~1 ug of DNA, with 20 units of T4 PNK but only 2 uL of 10 mM ATP → lesser ATP leading to insufficient phosphorylation (?)

These samples were concentrated in SpeedVac and frozen at \-20 C.
